exposure.needed: whether operators or scripts run bugtool with --k8s-mode (or --cilium-agent-container-name, --k8s-namespace, --k8s-label); bugtool is run by hand and is not set in workload configuration

consequence.statement: The bugtool --k8s-mode flag and its related flags still work in 1.17 but will be removed in Cilium 1.18.
consequence.remediation: Use the Cilium CLI to gather sysdumps from Kubernetes clusters instead of bugtool's k8s-mode.

assertion.statement: The bugtool flag --k8s-mode (and the related flags cilium-agent-container-name, k8s-namespace and k8s-label) is deprecated in 1.17 and will be removed in Cilium 1.18; use the Cilium CLI to gather a sysdump from a K8s cluster instead.
